name: Levoit Eleva 300X
summary: A small cylinder launched in 2026, with an AHAM Verifide CADR of 161 cfm, enough for a studio up to about 250 sq ft. HouseFresh named it the best small purifier for most people. It's new, so only two independent reviews exist so far.
idealFor: Small studios and alcoves up to about 250 sq ft
Tight floor space: about 9.4 in across
pros: AHAM Verifide CADR (161 cfm); HouseFresh measured 165 cfm
Separate HEPA (rated up to 2 years) and carbon filters, replaced on their own
cons: Too small for studios much over 250 sq ft
Clearly audible at top speed (55.4 dBA at 3 ft)
New model: only two independent reviews so far

trust.summary: Two independent hands-on reviews agree it works well for its size, and HouseFresh's measured CADR matches the AHAM-verified rating. Its CARB certification is on the state's public list, and Levoit publishes dimensions, weight, a 2-year warranty and a US address. Confidence is low because the model is new and has only two independent reviews.

sources.title: HouseFresh: The best small air purifiers
sources.note: Danny Ashton, Oct 2026, top pick. Tested in HouseFresh's room: PM1 CADR 165 cfm at top, 115 cfm under 45 dBA; 35.8 dBA (sleep) to 55.4 dBA (Turbo) at 3 ft
